findings.detail: Block 000076: the Russian now depicts Shane crumpling/falling onto the ice without inventing unconsciousness; source modality is preserved.
Block 000072: restored the crude border-official sexual-bribery exaggeration as idiomatic Russian, without an ungrammatical body-part construction.
Block 000113: the beads are explicitly identified as Ilya's gift to Shane, resolving pronoun ambiguity.
Block 000171: 'prospect cup' now denotes a prospects' event ('Кубок молодых талантов'), rather than a street-avenues false friend.
Block 000082: the figurative crash/dashcam judge and jury is now grammatical without adding an actual accident.
Block 000046: 'a hit to the head' accurately reads as a blow to the head, without wrongly implying a puck.
